title: Inanimate objects
content: I don't know why but yesterday night, I was in the school area of Mall World. Usually, the school is filled with people, but it was extremely empty in the area I was in. For some reason, I noticed an opened bag of M&Ms on a teacher's desk and all of a sudden the pieces of M&Ms started to jump towards me and started to bite my arms. I don't know why I get the most absurd moments in certain nights, but being attacked and chased by "inanimate objects" really does get me. Don't get me wrong, I usually get wonderful Mall World dreams, but there is always some odd event happening in my dreams.
